source.place: Lemma 35.8.5(2), local lifting and exactness of sheafified module pullback sections

title: Exactness of tensor sections at a module cokernel
statement: For a module morphism φ : F ⟶ G and its cokernel projection, the sheafified ULift tensor-section sequence is exact at the middle term. The module category is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], X is [def-pc-scheme], and the normalized tensor-section presheaves are [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial]. The given natural transformations are required to have exactly the tensor-pullback maps as components; they are not arbitrary morphisms. The equation w states that the induced consecutive sheaf maps compose to zero. The conclusion asserts only exactness, with no epimorphism assertion.

proof.text: Tensor pullback is a left adjoint, so it carries the module cokernel sequence to a cokernel sequence. Sectionwise kernels of the quotient are locally images, by the sheafified cokernel local-image theorem; normalized restrictions transport these local lifts to the étale tensor-section presheaves. Sheafification preserves this local kernel-image equality, and universe lifting preserves exactness. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting] on each etale object after the pullback adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]; use [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] for the unit-normalized restrictions.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleTensorSections_cokernel_exact {X : Scheme.{u}} {F G : X.Modules}
    (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (α : etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf F ⟶ etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf G)
    (β : etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf G ⟶ etaleTensorSectionsPresheaf (cokernel φ))
    (hα : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ, α.app U = ((tensorPullback U.unop.hom).map φ).app ⊤)
    (hβ : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ,
      β.app U = ((tensorPullback U.unop.hom).map (cokernel.π φ)).app ⊤)
    (w : ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight α AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})) ≫
      ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight β AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})) = 0) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight α AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}))
      ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight β AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u})) w).Exact
